== Summary ==
Slip “•Vader’s Machination” cut unchanged from page 2 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-22.pdf Virtual Set 22 release sheet] (PDF file created 6 October 2023), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (590, 52, 1102, 775)). Version [[Vader's Machination]] (Original). Not a recreation.
